# CLI Extractor Requirements Quality Checklist: Unified CLI Extractors (016-cli-extractors)

**Purpose**: Validate the clarity, completeness, consistency, and measurability of requirements for the 016-cli-extractors feature prior to task generation and implementation  
**Created**: 2026-11-03  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [cli-interface.md](../contracts/cli-interface.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. CLI Interface & Execution Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK001 - Are standardized Click CLI flags (`--output`, `--limit`, `--delay`, `--deep/--shallow`, `--cache/--no-cache`, `--split-size`, `--geocode`, `--tag`, `--dry-run`) comprehensively defined across all 5 extractor entrypoints? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK002 - Are default parameter values and type boundaries explicitly quantified for each CLI option (e.g., `--delay` $\ge 0.1$s, `--split-size` $\le 2000$)? [Clarity, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK003 - Is terminal exit code behavior unambiguously specified for success (`0`), runtime failure (`1`), and argument parsing errors (`2`)? [Completeness, Contract §3]
- [x] CHK004 - Does the specification clearly define standard output (human-readable summary table) versus standard error (diagnostic warnings) streaming boundaries? [Clarity, Contract §4]
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements for `--dry-run` execution explicitly defined regarding console output versus filesystem side-effects? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Contract §2]

---

## 2. Scraping Politeness, Rate-Limiting & Caching Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK006 - Is the outbound HTTP `User-Agent` string format and contact metadata strictly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the default politeness delay ($\ge 1.0$s per domain) quantified with measurable minimum timing thresholds? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK008 - Are retry intervals and backoff algorithms for transient HTTP failures (429, 500, 502, 503, 504) objectively testable without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Research §2]
- [x] CHK009 - Is local disk cache organization (`.cache/extractors/`) and cache key hashing strategy explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Research §2]
- [x] CHK010 - Are shallow (`--shallow`) versus deep (`--deep`) subpage traversal requirements unambiguously differentiated for each target domain? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-018]

## 3. Data Model & CSV Serialization Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK011 - Are all 19 standardized CSV column headers explicitly enumerated and mapped 1:1 to `ExtractorRecord` fields? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Data-Model §3]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the mandatory constraint requiring a non-empty string for `POI Name` verifiable for every extracted row? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK013 - Are coordinate formatting and decimal precision rules ($\le 6$ decimals, WGS-84 bounding boxes) defined for valid geographic output? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Contract §csv-schema.json]
- [x] CHK014 - Is missing data serialization consistently defined across all optional columns as empty string representation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the JSON serialization structure for the consolidated `Websites` column (`[{"name": "...", "url": "..."}]`) unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Data-Model §1.1]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the rule prohibiting dedicated `Official URL` and `Wiki URL` columns consistently maintained across all specification sections? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK017 - Are requirements for multi-location attractions clear regarding primary address column population versus JSON-encoded `Additional Address` entries? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-021]

## 4. Security & Ingestion Guardrails Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK018 - Are all spreadsheet formula injection prefix characters (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, `\t`, `\r`) explicitly identified for single-quote neutralization? [Security, Spec §FR-011, Data-Model §4]
- [x] CHK019 - Is formula injection defense required to execute at extraction time before CSV writing rather than relying purely on downstream ingestion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Research §3]
- [x] CHK020 - Is automatic file partitioning behavior (`{basename}_part{n}.csv`) precisely specified when row counts exceed 2,000 rows or `--split-size`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK021 - Are file partitioning requirements consistent with Vistarae Constitution Operational Invariant 1 ($\le 2,000$ rows, $\le 2\text{MB}$)? [Consistency, Constitution §Operational Invariants]
- [x] CHK022 - Is text truncation for `description` and `reason_to_visit` capped at 4,000 characters to match database limits? [Consistency, Data-Model §1.3]

- [x] CHK023 - Are Hillman Wonders tier tags (`HillmanWonder:Gold`, `HillmanWonder:Silver`, `HillmanWonder:Bronze`) explicitly specified with the prohibition of the base `Wonder` tag? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK024 - Is the baseline `NPS` tag plus official designation conditional tag (e.g. `National Park`, `National Historic Site`) unambiguously specified for National Park units? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK025 - Are Museum Ships tagging rules clear regarding the mandatory baseline `Ship` tag, conditional `Military` tag for warships, and exclusion of naval classification tags? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK026 - Are Castles tagging rules clear regarding the mandatory baseline `Fortification` tag and explicit omission of architectural classification tags? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK027 - Are Aircraft Museums tagging rules clear regarding the mandatory baseline `Aircraft` tag and explicit omission of collection focus tags? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK028 - Is the multi-tier tag combining and semicolon-delimited formatting logic (`Tag1; Tag2`) testable across all combinations of baseline, conditional, and `--tag` flags? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008]
